column2: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.audit_timeline AS  SELECT 'compliance'::text AS source,     cal.entry_id AS id,     COALESCE(cal."timestamp", cal.created_at) AS occurred_at,     cal.user_id,     cal.user_role AS actor_role,     cal.action_type::text AS action,     cal.object_type,     cal.object_id,     cal.before_value,     cal.after_value,     cal.justification,     cal.ip_address::text AS ip_address,     cal.user_agent,     cal.metadata    FROM compliance_audit_logs cal UNION ALL  SELECT 'security'::text AS source,     sel.id,     COALESCE(sel.event_time, sel.created_at) AS occurred_at,     sel.user_id,     sel.user_role AS actor_role,     sel.event_type::text AS action,     COALESCE(sel.target_resource, 'security'::text) AS object_type,     NULL::text AS object_id,     NULL::jsonb AS before_value,     sel.detail AS after_value,     NULL::text AS justification,     sel.ip_address::text AS ip_address,     sel.user_agent,     sel.metadata    FROM security_event_logs sel UNION ALL  SELECT 'legacy'::text AS source,     al.id,     al.created_at AS occurred_at,     al.user_id,     al.user_role AS actor_role,     al.action,     al.entity_type AS object_type,     al.entity_id AS object_id,     al.old_value AS before_value,     al.new_value AS after_value,     NULL::text AS justification,     NULL::text AS ip_address,     NULL::text AS user_agent,     al.metadata    FROM audit_logs al;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.escalation_health_signals AS  SELECT 'integration_failure'::text AS signal_key,     il.integration_key AS subject,     count(*)::integer AS failure_count,     max(il.created_at) AS last_seen,     'integration_failure'::text AS escalation_type    FROM integration_logs il   WHERE (il.status = ANY (ARRAY['error'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND il.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)   GROUP BY il.integration_key UNION ALL  SELECT 'background_job_failure'::text AS signal_key,     jq.type AS subject,     count(*)::integer AS failure_count,     max(jq.updated_at) AS last_seen,     'scheduler_failure'::text AS escalation_type    FROM job_queue jq   WHERE jq.status = 'failed'::text AND jq.updated_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)   GROUP BY jq.type UNION ALL  SELECT 'notification_queue_failure'::text AS signal_key,     'notification_outbox'::text AS subject,     count(*)::integer AS failure_count,     max(no2.created_at) AS last_seen,     'notification_delivery_failure'::text AS escalation_type    FROM notification_outbox no2   WHERE no2.status = 'failed'::text AND no2.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)  HAVING count(*) > 0 UNION ALL  SELECT 'repeated_email_failure'::text AS signal_key,     'email'::text AS subject,     count(*)::integer AS failure_count,     max(d.created_at) AS last_seen,     'notification_delivery_failure'::text AS escalation_type    FROM notification_dispatch_log d   WHERE d.channel = 'email'::text AND d.status = 'failed'::text AND d.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)  HAVING count(*) > 0 UNION ALL  SELECT 'sms_provider_failure'::text AS signal_key,     COALESCE(d.provider, 'sms'::text) AS subject,     count(*)::integer AS failure_count,     max(d.created_at) AS last_seen,     'notification_delivery_failure'::text AS escalation_type    FROM notification_dispatch_log d   WHERE d.channel = 'sms'::text AND d.status = 'failed'::text AND d.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)   GROUP BY (COALESCE(d.provider, 'sms'::text));

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.report_runs AS  SELECT id,     report_definition_id,     report_slug,     name AS report_name,     category,     source,     COALESCE(filters_json, COALESCE(query_config -> 'filters'::text, '{}'::jsonb)) AS filters_json,     selected_columns,     group_by,     sort_by,     sort_dir,     result_summary,     status,     COALESCE(result_count, 0) AS row_count,     created_by AS generated_by,     generated_at,     started_at,     completed_at,     error_message,     duration_ms,     created_at    FROM reports;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.report_view_applications AS  SELECT a.id,     a.application_number,     a.applicant_id,     p.full_name AS applicant_name,     p.entity_name,     COALESCE(NULLIF(p.entity_name, ''::text), NULLIF(p.full_name, ''::text), NULLIF(p.email, ''::text), 'Unknown'::text) AS applicant_entity_name,     a.license_type,     a.status,     a.regulator_id,     r.name AS regulator_name,     a.ack_by AS assigned_officer_id,     op.full_name AS assigned_officer_name,     a.submitted_at,     a.approved_at,     a.rejected_at,     a.created_at,     a.updated_at,     EXTRACT(day FROM now() - COALESCE(a.submitted_at, a.created_at))::integer AS aging_days    FROM applications a      LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = a.applicant_id      LEFT JOIN profiles op ON op.id = a.ack_by      LEFT JOIN regulators r ON r.id = a.regulator_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.report_view_complaints AS  SELECT c.id,     c.complaint_number,     c.complainant_id,     cp.full_name AS complainant_name,     COALESCE(NULLIF(cp.entity_name, ''::text), NULLIF(cp.full_name, ''::text), NULLIF(cp.email, ''::text), NULLIF(c.email, ''::text), 'Unknown'::text) AS applicant_entity_name,     c.complaint_type_id AS category_id,     ct.name AS category_name,     ct.name AS complaint_type,     c.regulator_id,     r.name AS regulator_name,     c.investigator_id AS assigned_officer_id,     ip.full_name AS assigned_officer_name,     c.status,     c.subject,     c.created_at,     c.updated_at,     EXTRACT(day FROM COALESCE(c.updated_at, now()) - c.created_at)::integer AS resolution_days,     c.sla_days,     c.sla_due_at    FROM complaints c      LEFT JOIN profiles cp ON cp.id = c.complainant_id      LEFT JOIN profiles ip ON ip.id = c.investigator_id      LEFT JOIN complaint_types ct ON ct.id = c.complaint_type_id      LEFT JOIN regulators r ON r.id = c.regulator_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.report_view_compliance_returns AS  SELECT cr.id,     (to_char(cr.period_start::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) || ' to '::text) || to_char(cr.period_end::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS return_period,     cr.period_start,     cr.period_end,     cr.license_id,     l.license_number,     hp.licensee_id,     li.name AS licensee_name,     COALESCE(NULLIF(li.name, ''::text), NULLIF(hp.entity_name, ''::text), NULLIF(hp.full_name, ''::text), 'Unknown'::text) AS applicant_entity_name,     l.sector_id,     s.name AS sector_name,     l.regulator_id,     r.name AS regulator_name,     cr.status,     cr.due_date,     cr.submitted_at,         CASE             WHEN cr.submitted_at IS NULL AND cr.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN CURRENT_DATE - cr.due_date             ELSE 0         END AS days_overdue,     cr.created_at,     cr.updated_at    FROM compliance_returns cr      LEFT JOIN licenses l ON l.id = cr.license_id      LEFT JOIN profiles hp ON hp.id = l.holder_id      LEFT JOIN licensees li ON li.id = hp.licensee_id      LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = l.sector_id      LEFT JOIN regulators r ON r.id = l.regulator_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.report_view_licenses AS  SELECT l.id,     l.license_number,     l.license_type,     l.status,     l.application_id,     a.application_number,     l.holder_id,     hp.full_name AS holder_name,     a.applicant_id,     ap.full_name AS applicant_name,     ap.entity_name,     hp.licensee_id,     li.name AS licensee_name,     COALESCE(NULLIF(li.name, ''::text), NULLIF(hp.entity_name, ''::text), NULLIF(hp.full_name, ''::text), NULLIF(ap.entity_name, ''::text), NULLIF(ap.full_name, ''::text), NULLIF(ap.email, ''::text), 'Unknown'::text) AS applicant_entity_name,     l.sector_id,     s.name AS sector_name,     l.sub_sector_id,     ss.name AS sub_sector_name,     l.regulator_id,     r.name AS regulator_name,     l.issued_at,     l.valid_from,     l.valid_until,     l.valid_until AS expiry_date,         CASE             WHEN l.valid_until IS NULL THEN NULL::integer             ELSE EXTRACT(day FROM l.valid_until - now())::integer         END AS days_to_expiry,     l.created_at,     l.updated_at    FROM licenses l      LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.id = l.application_id      LEFT JOIN profiles hp ON hp.id = l.holder_id      LEFT JOIN profiles ap ON ap.id = a.applicant_id      LEFT JOIN licensees li ON li.id = hp.licensee_id      LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = l.sector_id      LEFT JOIN sub_sectors ss ON ss.id = l.sub_sector_id      LEFT JOIN regulators r ON r.id = l.regulator_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.report_view_payments AS  SELECT pm.id,     pm.transaction_ref AS payment_reference,     pm.transaction_ref AS transaction_id,     pm.amount,     pm.currency,     pm.status,     pm.paid_at AS payment_date,     pm.created_at,     pm.application_id,     a.application_number,     pm.user_id AS payer_id,     up.full_name AS payer_name,     COALESCE(NULLIF(up.entity_name, ''::text), NULLIF(up.full_name, ''::text), NULLIF(up.email, ''::text), NULLIF(ap.entity_name, ''::text), NULLIF(ap.full_name, ''::text), 'Unknown'::text) AS applicant_entity_name,     a.regulator_id,     r.name AS regulator_name    FROM payments pm      LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.id = pm.application_id      LEFT JOIN profiles up ON up.id = pm.user_id      LEFT JOIN profiles ap ON ap.id = a.applicant_id      LEFT JOIN regulators r ON r.id = a.regulator_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.sec_assignment_parity AS  SELECT COALESCE(l.user_id, s.user_id) AS user_id,     COALESCE(l.role_id, s.role_id) AS role_id,     r.name AS role_name,     l.user_id IS NOT NULL AS in_legacy,     s.user_id IS NOT NULL AS in_canonical,         CASE             WHEN l.user_id IS NOT NULL AND s.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'match'::text             WHEN l.user_id IS NULL THEN 'canonical_only'::text             ELSE 'legacy_only'::text         END AS parity    FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT user_dynamic_roles.user_id,             user_dynamic_roles.role_id            FROM user_dynamic_roles) l      FULL JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT sec_user_roles.user_id,             sec_user_roles.role_id            FROM sec_user_roles           WHERE sec_user_roles.status = 'active'::text) s ON s.user_id = l.user_id AND s.role_id = l.role_id      LEFT JOIN sec_roles r ON r.id = COALESCE(l.role_id, s.role_id);

entered_stage_at,             max(ev2.created_at) AS last_activity_at            FROM enforcement_actions ea_1              LEFT JOIN enforcement_case_events ev ON ev.case_id = ea_1.id AND (ev.detail  ea.case_number,     ea.entity_id,     l.name AS entity_name,     ea.enforcement_type,     ea.stage,     s.label AS stage_label,     s.seq AS stage_seq,     s.is_terminal,     ea.status, CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.v_prudential_current_breaches AS  SELECT b.id,     b.return_id,     b.return_config_id,     b.metric_key,     b.level,     b.value,     b.threshold_value,     b.comparator,     b.detected_at,     b.notified,     b.risk_level,     b.threshold_version,     COALESCE(b.acknowledged_at, ack.acknowledged_at) AS acknowledged_at,     COALESCE(b.acknowledged_by, ack.acknowledged_by) AS acknowledged_by,     COALESCE(b.acknowledgement_note, ack.note) AS acknowledgement_note,     b.escalated_enforcement_id,     b.escalated_at,     b.escalated_by,     b.entity_id,     b.return_filing_id,     b.return_filing_version_id,     b.reporting_period_id,     b.regulatory_metric_id,     b.detection_source,     b.detection_run_id,     b.evidence,     rp.period_label,     rp.period_end,     f.filing_reference,     f.status AS filing_status,     ack.id AS acknowledgement_id,     ack.acknowledged_by AS acknowledged_by_user,     ack.acknowledged_at AS acknowledged_at_ts,     ack.note AS acknowledgement_note_text    FROM return_threshold_breaches b      JOIN return_filings f ON f.id = b.return_filing_id      LEFT JOIN reporting_periods rp ON rp.id = b.reporting_period_id      LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.id,             a.acknowledged_by,             a.acknowledged_at,             a.note            FROM return_threshold_breach_acknowledgements a           WHERE a.breach_id = b.id           ORDER BY a.acknowledged_at DESC NULLS LAST          LIMIT 1) ack ON true   WHERE b.detection_source = 'CANONICAL_ENGINE'::text AND COALESCE(f.status, ''::text) <> 'WITHDRAWN'::text AND b.detection_run_id = (( SELECT r.id            FROM prudential_detection_runs r           WHERE r.return_filing_version_id = b.return_filing_version_id           ORDER BY r.started_at DESC NULLS LAST          LIMIT 1));

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.v_prudential_early_warnings AS  WITH ranked AS (          SELECT rcr.ratio_key,             rcr.value,             rcr.computed_at,             rf.entity_id AS licensee_id,             rf.sector_id,             s.regulator_id,             row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY rf.entity_id, rcr.ratio_key ORDER BY rcr.computed_at DESC) AS rn            FROM return_calculated_ratios rcr              JOIN returns_filed rf ON rf.id = rcr.return_id              LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = rf.sector_id           WHERE rcr.value IS NOT NULL AND rf.entity_id IS NOT NULL         ), latest_ratios AS (          SELECT ranked.ratio_key,             ranked.value,             ranked.computed_at,             ranked.licensee_id,             ranked.sector_id,             ranked.regulator_id,             ranked.rn            FROM ranked           WHERE ranked.rn = 1         ), prev_ratios AS (          SELECT ranked.ratio_key,             ranked.value,             ranked.computed_at,             ranked.licensee_id,             ranked.sector_id,             ranked.regulator_id,             ranked.rn            FROM ranked           WHERE ranked.rn = 2         ), breach_counts AS (          SELECT rf.entity_id AS licensee_id,             rtb.metric_key AS ratio_key,             count(*)::integer AS breach_count            FROM return_threshold_breaches rtb              JOIN returns_filed rf ON rf.id = rtb.return_id           WHERE rtb.detected_at > (now() - '180 days'::interval) AND rf.entity_id IS NOT NULL           GROUP BY rf.entity_id, rtb.metric_key         )  SELECT l.id AS licensee_id,     l.name AS licensee_name,     latest.regulator_id,     latest.sector_id,     latest.ratio_key,     latest.value AS current_value,     prev.value AS previous_value,         CASE             WHEN prev.value IS NULL OR prev.value = 0::numeric THEN NULL::numeric             ELSE round((latest.value - prev.value) / abs(prev.value) * 100::numeric, 2)         END AS delta_pct,     COALESCE(bc.breach_count, 0) AS recent_breach_count,         CASE             WHEN COALESCE(bc.breach_count, 0) >= 2 THEN 'critical'::text             WHEN prev.value IS NOT NULL AND prev.value <> 0::numeric AND abs((latest.value - b.requires_declaration,             b.reporting_period_id,             b.period_label,             b.period_start,             b.period_end,             b.due_date,             b.status,             b.current_version_number,             b.accepted_version_id,             b.submitted_at,             b.accepted_at,             b.rejected_at,             b.updated_at,             b.owner_user_id,             b.owner_name,             b.team,             b.current_version_id,             b.current_version_status,             b.declaration_accepted_at,             b.blocking_validation_count,             b.open_request_count,             b.incomplete_required_forms,                 CASE b.status                     WHEN 'DRAFT'::text THEN 'ENTITY_PREPARATION'::text                     WHEN 'CORRECTION_REQUESTED'::text THEN 'CORRECTION'::text                     WHEN 'SUBMITTED'::text THEN 'SUBMITTED_INTAKE'::text                     WHEN 'UNDER_REVIEW'::text THEN 'REGULATOR_REVIEW'::text                     WHEN 'ACCEPTED'::text THEN 'CLOSED'::text                     WHEN 'REJECTED'::text THEN 'CLOSED'::text                     WHEN 'WITHDRAWN'::text THEN 'CLOSED'::text                     ELSE 'ENTITY_PREPARATION'::text                 END AS stage,                 CASE b.status                     WHEN 'DRAFT'::text THEN 'ENTITY'::text                     WHEN 'CORRECTION_REQUESTED'::text THEN 'ENTITY'::text                     WHEN 'SUBMITTED'::text THEN 'REGULATOR'::text                     WHEN 'UNDER_REVIEW'::text THEN                     CASE                         WHEN b.open_request_count > 0 THEN 'ENTITY'::text                         ELSE 'REGULATOR'::text                     END                     ELSE 'NOBODY'::text                 END AS waiting_on,             (b.status <> ALL (ARRAY['ACCEPTED'::text, 'WITHDRAWN'::text, 'REJECTED'::text])) AND b.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AS is_overdue,             GREATEST(0, COALESCE(b.submitted_at::date, CURRENT_DATE) - b.due_date) AS days_late,                 CASE                     WHEN b.status = ANY (ARRAY['ACCEPTED'::text, 'REJECTED'::text, 'WITHDRAWN'::text]) THEN NULL::timestamp with time zone                     WHEN b.status = ANY (ARRAY['SUBMITTED'::text, 'UNDER_REVIEW'::text]) THEN COALESCE(b.submitted_at, b.updated_at) + make_interval(days => COALESCE(b.review_sla_days, 10))                     ELSE (b.due_date + 1)::timestamp with time zone                 END AS sla_due_at            FROM base b         )  SELECT filing_id,     filing_reference,     entity_id,     entity_name,     return_definition_id,     definition_code,     definition_name,     frequency,     review_sla_days,     requires_declaration,     reporting_period_id,     period_label,     period_start,     period_end,     due_date,     status,     current_version_number,     accepted_version_id,     submitted_at,     accepted_at,     rejected_at,     updated_at,     owner_user_id,     owner_name,     team,     current_version_id,     current_version_status,     declaration_accepted_at,     blocking_validation_count,     open_request_count,     incomplete_required_forms,     stage,     waiting_on,     is_overdue,     days_late,     sla_due_at,         CASE stage             WHEN 'ENTITY_PREPARATION'::text THEN 'Entity preparation'::text             WHEN 'CORRECTION'::text THEN 'Correction'::text             WHEN 'SUBMITTED_INTAKE'::text THEN 'Submitted — intake'::text             WHEN 'REGULATOR_REVIEW'::text THEN 'Regulator review'::text             WHEN 'CLOSED'::text THEN 'Closed'::text             ELSE NULL::text         END AS stage_label,         CASE status             WHEN 'DRAFT'::text THEN requested'::text             WHEN 'ACCEPTED'::text THEN 'Accepted'::text             WHEN 'REJECTED'::text THEN 'Rejected'::text             WHEN 'WITHDRAWN'::text THEN 'Withdrawn'::text             ELSE status         END AS status_label,         CASE             WHEN sla_due_at IS NULL THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text             WHEN sla_due_at < now() THEN 'BREACHED'::text             WHEN sla_due_at < (now() + '3 days'::interval) THEN 'DUE_SOON'::text             ELSE 'ON_TRACK'::text         END AS sla_state,     blocking_validation_count + open_request_count +         CASE             WHEN status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::text, 'CORRECTION_REQUESTED'::text]) THEN incomplete_required_forms             ELSE 0::bigint         END +         CASE             WHEN (status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::text, 'CORRECTION_REQUESTED'::text])) AND requires_declaration AND declaration_accepted_at IS NULL THEN 1             ELSE 0         END AS blocker_count,         CASE             WHEN status = ANY (ARRAY['ACCEPTED'::text, 'REJECTED'::text, 'WITHDRAWN'::text]) THEN 'NONE'::text             WHEN sla_due_at IS NOT NULL AND sla_due_at < now() THEN 'CRITICAL'::text             WHEN is_overdue THEN 'CRITICAL'::text             WHEN blocking_validation_count > 0 THEN 'HIGH'::text             WHEN sla_due_at IS NOT NULL AND sla_due_at < (now() + '3 days'::interval) THEN 'HIGH'::text             WHEN open_request_count > 0 THEN 'MEDIUM'::text             ELSE 'NORMAL'::text         END AS priority,         CASE             WHEN status = ANY (ARRAY['ACCEPTED'::text, 'REJECTED'::text, 'WITHDRAWN'::text]) THEN 'Filing closed'::text             WHEN sla_due_at IS NOT NULL AND sla_due_at < now() THEN 'Service level breached'::text             WHEN is_overdue THEN 'Past the regulatory due date'::text             WHEN blocking_validation_count > 0 THEN 'Blocking validation findings outstanding'::text             WHEN sla_due_at IS NOT NULL AND sla_due_at < (now() + '3 days'::interval) THEN 'Service level due within three days'::text             WHEN open_request_count > 0 THEN 'Open correction request awaiting the entity'::text             ELSE 'Within service level'::text         END AS priority_reason,     GREATEST(updated_at, COALESCE(submitted_at, updated_at)) AS last_activity_at,         CASE status             WHEN 'SUBMITTED'::text THEN 'START_REVIEW'::text             WHEN 'UNDER_REVIEW'::text THEN             CASE                 WHEN blocking_validation_count > 0 THEN 'RESOLVE_VALIDATION'::text                 WHEN open_request_count > 0 THEN 'AWAIT_ENTITY_RESPONSE'::text                 ELSE 'DECIDE'::text             END             WHEN 'CORRECTION_REQUESTED'::text THEN 'AWAIT_ENTITY_CORRECTION'::text             WHEN 'DRAFT'::text THEN 'AWAIT_ENTITY_SUBMISSION'::text             ELSE 'NONE'::text         END AS next_action,         CASE status             WHEN 'SUBMITTED'::text THEN 'Start regulatory review'::text             WHEN 'UNDER_REVIEW'::text THEN             CASE                 WHEN blocking_validation_count > 0 THEN 'Resolve blocking validation findings'::text                 WHEN open_request_count > 0 THEN 'Awaiting the entity''s response to a correction request'::text                 ELSE 'Accept or reject the filing'::text             END             WHEN 'CORRECTION_REQUESTED'::text THEN 'Awaiting corrected submission from the entity'::text             WHEN 'DRAFT'::text THEN 'Awaiting submission by the entity'::text             ELSE 'No action required'::text         END AS next_action_label,     '/returns/filings/'::text || filing_id::text AS next_action_href,         CASE status             WHEN 'SUBMITTED'::text THEN 'returns_management.review'::text             WHEN 'UNDER_REVIEW'::text THEN             CASE                 WHEN blocking_validation_count > 0 OR open_request_count > 0 THEN 'returns_management.review'::text                 ELSE 'returns_management.approve'::text             END             ELSE NULL::text         END AS next_action_permission    FROM staged s;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.v_return_metric_facts_current AS  SELECT mv.id AS metric_value_id,     mv.entity_id,     f.id AS filing_id,     mv.return_filing_version_id AS filing_version_id,     f.status AS filing_status,     ver.status AS version_status,     mv.reporting_period_id,     p.period_end,     p.period_label,     m.id AS regulatory_metric_id,     m.code AS metric_code,     m.name AS metric_name,     m.unit AS metric_unit,     mv.value_numeric,     mv.availability,     mv.source_kind,     f.updated_at AS filing_updated_at    FROM return_metric_values mv      JOIN regulatory_metrics m ON m.id = mv.regulatory_metric_id      JOIN return_filing_versions ver ON ver.id = mv.return_filing_version_id      JOIN return_filings f ON f.id = ver.return_filing_id      JOIN reporting_periods p ON p.id = mv.reporting_period_id   WHERE mv.return_filing_version_id = COALESCE(f.accepted_version_id, ( SELECT v2.id            FROM return_filing_versions v2           WHERE v2.return_filing_id = f.id AND v2.version_number = f.current_version_number          LIMIT 1));

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.workflow_steps_legacy_role_report AS  SELECT w.name AS workflow_name,     s.name AS step_name,     s.step_order,     s.approver_role::text AS legacy_approver_role,     s.approver_role_id,     r.name AS resolved_role_name,         CASE             WHEN s.approver_role_id IS NULL THEN 'NEEDS_FIX'::text             ELSE 'OK'::text         END AS status    FROM approval_steps s      JOIN approval_workflows w ON w.id = s.workflow_id      LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = s.approver_role_id   ORDER BY (         CASE             WHEN s.approver_role_id IS NULL THEN 'NEEDS_FIX'::text             ELSE 'OK'::text         END) DESC, w.name, s.step_order;
